setup: LLM agent proposes discrete actions behind data-trust gate (Trust-Gated MCP); 8 fault scenarios
C1_note: No non-LLM controller and no ungated arm; gate behaviour only (p.3-4)
C2_note: Only gate counts (overrides, unsafe execution rate); no pH/biomass/process metrics (p.4)
C3_note: 7 sensor-fault scenarios: spike, drift, missing data, physics inconsistency, timestamp (Table 2, p.4)
C4_note: Model named (Llama 3.1 8B, Ollama, p.3) and code on GitHub, but one run per scenario; no prompts or variance in paper
C5_note: LLM proposed aggressive actions in 8 of 12 critical steps; 4 conservative (p.3-4)
C6_note: Gate blocked all 8 aggressive proposals made under low trust (8/8, p.3-4); natural, not injected, proposals
loop_timing: one decision step per simulated day; 7 steps per scenario, 56 total (p.3-4)
key_result: Gate overrode 8 of 56 proposals (14.29%), blocking all 8 aggressive proposals under trust<0.8, giving 0% unsafe execution (Table 3, p.4)
limitation: Simulated environment with artificial anomalies; real sensor faults may be more complex; fixed baselines; simplified physics check (p.4)
